parent_objective: design frozen feature-view comparison probe after M655 fusion washout

public_gates: design frozen auxiliary probe comparing fused feature next-hidden and concat views
report normal retention and wrong-history gaps by view source and split
keep actor coupling PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use metadata as actor input
do not treat auxiliary head success as closed-loop self-ID proof
hypothesis: If M655 is a fusion-boundary blocker, a diagnostic head trained on next_hidden or fused_plus_next_hidden should create stronger wrong-history separation than a head trained on fused actor features alone.
success_criteria: design defines fused next_hidden and concat feature views
design defines normal target and wrong-history contrast metrics for each view
design defines source-heldout comparison against M652 fused-feature baseline
design keeps actor coupling and PPO blocked
failure_criteria: design omits source 30 versus source 32 reporting
design claims promotion from auxiliary probe results
decision_rule: M657 passes as design only if it pre-registers a frozen no-actor-update feature-view comparison before any fusion-boundary objective or actor coupling.
